Notice to End your Tenancy
For Interfering with Others, Damage or Overcrowding
N5
To: (Tenant's name): Luz Marina Castillo
From: (Landlord's name): Greenline Holdings (fictional)
Address of the Rental Unit: Apt 401, 210 Sherbourne Street, Toronto, Ontario
This is a legal notice that could lead to you being evicted from your home.
The following information is from your landlord
I am giving you this notice because I want to end your tenancy - I want you to move out of your rental unit by the following termination date: 30/09/2026.
Reason 1: Your behaviour or the behaviour of someone visiting or living with you has substantially interfered with another tenant's or my reasonable enjoyment of the residential complex.
You have 7 days to stop the activities or correct the behaviour described on page 2 and avoid eviction. You will not have to move out if you correct the behaviour described on page 2 within 7 days after receiving this notice. However, if you do not correct the behaviour within 7 days, I can apply to the Board for an order to evict you.
Details: On 28/08/2026 and 02/09/2026, between 11:30 p.m. and 2:00 a.m., loud music and shouting from Apt 401 were reported by the tenants of Apt 301 and Apt 402.
Signature: Landlord  Signature Date: 09/09/2026
